description:
Seorim wants to spend a perfect Christmas with his lover, so he tries to book a hotel — only to be crushed by the outrageous prices. But just as he’s about to give up, he wins the lottery?!

A special Christmas side story to [My X Report](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=35738920748)!

---

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/my_x_mas), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/hotel_christmas)

**Official Translations:**  
[Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/x-mas_report), [T.Chinese](https://www.bomtoon.tw/detail/my_x_mas)

***Note:**  
Part of Penis Navida: [Hotel XMAS](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=3350491531) 2020 event by Bomtoon, this is Story 3 (Ch.8-10) on Lezhin*
